pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions with irregular, jagged edges characterized by high-frequency crenulations. Patches on the upper neck exhibit greater surface area and closer proximity compared to the slightly more spaced and angular patches on the mid-to-lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological graph. Nodes are predominantly tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the central flank, with slight widening at major junction points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal line from the mid-neck to the shoulder. Individual hair tufts create a low-amplitude jagged edge against the background sky and foliage.
